verdict.rationale: a-Shell's only documented event-driven mechanism of its own is that it automatically runs a user-defined `.profile` whenever a new window opens, which can set environment variables or clean up temporary files. Its Apple Shortcuts actions (Execute Command, Put/Get File) let iOS Shortcuts run a-Shell commands, but the event triggers and rules there belong to the host platform, not to a-Shell. missing for 10: a general user-definable rule/trigger system, triggers beyond window open (file changes, schedules, app events), conditional rule logic, independent corroboration.
